description: Is tracking working? lastEventAt + hoursSinceLastEvent, install scan (snippetStatus, detected stack, CSP blocking the script), lastRejection (why recent events were refused, e.g. origin_mismatch or subscription_inactive; null when the last accepted event is newer) and the site-health score (score, grade, categories, stale). Never triggers a scan: install.scannedAt null means not scanned yet. Read-only.
name: get_site_health
title: Get site tracking health
